FRONTIER STRAIN

Strain 0, rising 0.1 a day

The frontier wears on everyone, more as the colony grows and as the weeks go by. How comfortable people are sets how fast: a comfortable colony strains far slower.

Comfort 100%, so strain rises at 0.40×. A fully comfortable colony would rise at 0.4×.

Your town is a camp. Its comfort counts:

Shelter
100%
Food
100%
A fire
100%

At the next charter the town becomes a settlement, and people expect more: meals, health, evenings, a cold drink start to count, and cooked meals replace any old food.

It eases when a charter is finished (by 30%) or when you hold a festival.
